integrity.cubic_exception_basis: Han's explicit Aronhold formula evaluates nonzero on a three-support cubic monomial.
integrity.first_public_date_basis: The earliest primary archival source used here, arXiv:1111.4567, was submitted on 2011-11-19.
integrity.localization_basis: A generic diagonal cocharacter separates all degree-d monomial weights, and projective Euler characteristic localizes to the fixed locus.
integrity.monomial_lower_bounds: Catalecticant rank gives border-rank lower bounds; support at least four or three-support degree at least four forces a rank-at-least-four catalecticant.
integrity.monomial_upper_bounds: Explicit two- and three-power finite-difference degenerations put the exponent patterns with smaller exponent one or two into the second or third secant.
integrity.object_basis: The cited sources identify the third Veronese secant with symmetric border rank at most three and develop the relevant catalecticants and Aronhold equation.
integrity.primary_slot_basis: arXiv:1111.4567 lists MSC 14M12 first; arXiv:1411.5063 independently lists 14M12 first.

scientific_limitations: Only ordinary Euler characteristic of the projective third secant and compactly supported Euler characteristic of its exact third layer are computed.
No claim is made about Betti numbers, Hodge data, motives, intersection cohomology, projective degree, or fourth and higher secants.
The fixed-point reduction is short enough that an equivalent unindexed or differently phrased observation remains possible.
title: Euler characteristic of the third Veronese secant has three degree regimes
